entities.summary: Open-source self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning mobile wallet from Synonym with an embedded Lightning node.
entities.notes: Current first-party Bitkit material explicitly describes Bitkit as a fully self-custodial mobile wallet and states the Lightning node runs inside the wallet. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Bitcoin Lightning software ecosystem whose Breez Mobile wallet runs a non-custodial Lightning node on the user's mobile device.
entities.notes: Breez's current company focus includes SDK infrastructure, but the first-party Breez Mobile page remains a distinct non-custodial wallet product. WLR selects that wallet boundary rather than treating the SDK itself as a wallet.

entities.summary: Open-source self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning wallet supporting embedded-node and bring-your-own-node configurations.
entities.notes: Current first-party ZEUS page states the wallet is open-source, self-custodial and shipping since 2019. Year precision only.

entities.summary: Open-source non-custodial Bitcoin Lightning mobile wallet running lnd and Neutrino directly on the user's phone.
entities.notes: Current first-party project page explicitly calls Blixt non-custodial and states lnd/Neutrino run directly on the phone without centralized transaction servers. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Historical Android Bitcoin privacy wallet whose web servers/domain were seized by law enforcement in April 2024 and whose business was closed.
entities.notes: The official source repository establishes the historical Android wallet. U.S. DOJ records say Samourai was developed/operated from about 2015 and that its web servers/domain were seized on 2024-04-24, with the FBI stating the business was closed. The still-accessible source repository is not treated as active-service evidence.

products.summary: Bitkit open-source self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning mobile wallet.
products.notes: First-party material explicitly distinguishes its embedded Lightning node from custodial wallet architecture.

products.summary: Breez non-custodial Lightning mobile wallet with a Lightning node running on the user's device.
products.notes: Selected wallet product only; Breez SDK infrastructure is not modeled as the user-facing wallet in this breadth pass.

products.summary: ZEUS self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning mobile wallet supporting embedded and remote-node configurations.
products.notes: First-party current page states ZEUS has been shipping since 2019; year precision only.

products.summary: Blixt non-custodial open-source Bitcoin Lightning mobile wallet.
products.notes: Current project page states lnd and Neutrino run directly on the phone.

products.summary: Historical Samourai Android Bitcoin wallet, no longer operating after the April 2024 law-enforcement seizure and closure.
products.notes: DOJ states Samourai's web servers/domain were seized on 2024-04-24, a seizure warrant was served on the Google Play app, and the business was closed. The source repository remains available but is not evidence of current service/support.
